what_must_be_true: Policy documents with version number and approval date
evidence_required: Drive link to each approved policy; screenshot of version history

what_must_be_true: Complete list of applications, domains and cloud services
evidence_required: Export or screenshot of the inventory sheet, dated

what_must_be_true: User list per system with role and last review date
evidence_required: Admin console user export (CSV) + signed review record

what_must_be_true: Provider assurance reports on file
evidence_required: SOC 2 / ISO certificate PDF per provider, with issue date

what_must_be_true: Signed DPA or security terms per subprocessor
evidence_required: Executed agreement PDF

what_must_be_true: Evidence that provider controls were reviewed, not assumed
evidence_required: Dated review note naming the report read and the date read

what_must_be_true: Documented incident response plan
evidence_required: Plan document with version and approval date

what_must_be_true: Register of applicable obligations
evidence_required: Obligations register with source citation per line

what_must_be_true: Published privacy notice; working deletion route
evidence_required: Screenshot of live notice with URL and date; test deletion record

what_must_be_true: External review report
evidence_required: Report PDF from the reviewer

what_must_be_true: Training completion record
evidence_required: Completion export or signed acknowledgement per person

what_must_be_true: Remote working policy acknowledged
evidence_required: Signed acknowledgement

what_must_be_true: Device register with encryption status
evidence_required: Screenshot of disk-encryption status per device, dated

what_must_be_true: Encryption, auto-update and screen lock enforced
evidence_required: Settings screenshot per device showing the system clock

what_must_be_true: List of privileged accounts per system with justification
evidence_required: Admin role export (CSV) per system

what_must_be_true: MFA enforced on all administrative accounts
evidence_required: Per service: screenshot of the enforcement setting AND the per-user MFA status export

what_must_be_true: Spend caps and alerts configured
evidence_required: Screenshot of the limit configuration per provider

what_must_be_true: Alert count by severity and age of oldest open
evidence_required: Dependency alert export (CSV) with export date

what_must_be_true: Restore actually performed and verified
evidence_required: Restore log: source, target, start and end time, outcome, tester name

what_must_be_true: Logging enabled with defined retention
evidence_required: Screenshot of retention configuration + one sample log entry

what_must_be_true: TLS in transit, encryption at rest
evidence_required: SSL Labs report; provider encryption-at-rest statement

what_must_be_true: Secret scanning and push protection enabled
evidence_required: Repository security settings screenshot

what_must_be_true: Preview and production separated
evidence_required: Deployment configuration screenshot

what_must_be_true: Changes reviewed before promotion
evidence_required: Sample of 5 changes with review record
